globalConstraints: Security, quality and performance gates precede feature completeness.
Contracts and accepted specifications are read-only unless architecture and security approve a coordinated change.
No Clever Cloud resource, secret, DNS, database or environment is configured before G4.
No legacy Git history, compatibility layer or historical product database is imported.
Bun.serve, strict TypeScript and React 19 own web boundaries without an added web framework.
Rust is retained only behind a cataloged WIT, authz, proof, artifact or system-tooling boundary.
Applications never read or write another product database and never query across tenants.
Every branch is bounded by declared write paths and reports security, PII, tests and evidence before integration.
Authoring and review are separate passes for every schema, authorization, migration, release or deployment change.
ADR-0003 contract candidates use dedicated review-only passes per role on immutable commits; the same agent/session may act serially and CI is evidence, not a verdict.

ADR-0005 permits only the disabled public-fixture Notebook Gate B slice under the future WP-G3-N01 path before G3; this bounded owner exception grants no user data, feature activation, release, physical-evidence waiver or root-lockfile ownership.
Clever Cloud Paris EU remains the runtime target and production data never enters GitHub.

WP-G3-A01 remains blocked from orchestrator integration until WP-G2-A01 implementation and conformance review pass; the current Specification Lock and package definition authorize contracts and simulation-only control work, not a harness, Pi worker or real mission.

packages.name: Production toolchain and dependency authority
packages.objective: Replace the bootstrap-only Bun canary with a qualified stable Rust-line release and remain the sole integrator of root version catalogs and lockfiles.
acceptance: A clean Linux x64 checkout verifies exact binaries, source, notices and checksums.
Bun, TypeScript, browser and Cargo gates pass without a bootstrap-only production exception.
Every later root dependency request is integrated here with exact version, licence, advisory and source evidence.
Failure leaves production and Clever provisioning explicitly blocked.

packages.name: Contract SDK and boundary validators
packages.objective: Build disposable TypeScript and Rust projections plus runtime validators from the locked JSON Schema, OpenAPI, WIT and policy authorities.
acceptance: All cataloged schemas validate positive and negative vectors in TypeScript and Rust.
Generated projections are reproducible and clearly non-authoritative.
Unknown fields, versions and unresolved references fail closed.

packages.name: Knowledge and ecosystem engine
packages.objective: Implement versioned Knowledge Objects, graph rules, provenance and deterministic public projections without importing legacy history.
acceptance: Graph ingestion rejects invalid, cyclic-forbidden and untrusted authority transitions.
The same inputs produce byte-identical selected projections.
Legacy provenance remains SHA-referenced without Git history import.

packages.name: Bun React web platform and design foundation
packages.objective: Deliver the direct Bun.serve application shell, React SSR/hydration/static modes, accessible primitives, local-first PWA support and canonical app template.
acceptance: One template serves SSR, hydration, static and JSON routes through direct Bun.serve.
Keyboard, focus, reduced-motion, no-JS and three-engine browser fixtures pass.
No forbidden web framework, remote runtime asset or second lockfile is introduced.

packages.name: OIDC and opaque browser session capability
packages.objective: Implement provider-neutral OIDC PKCE, opaque keyed-digest sessions, CSRF, fixation rotation, logout and browser-safe session projections.
acceptance: State, nonce, PKCE, issuer, audience, expiry and replay negative vectors fail closed.
Cookie attributes, CSRF, rotation, idle/absolute expiry and logout pass real-browser tests.
Provider tokens, cookie values and CSRF secrets are absent from logs and storage projections.

packages.name: Biscuit authorization capability
packages.objective: Implement Ed25519 authority issuance, monotonic attenuation, deny-by-default authorizers, root-block revocation and two-key rotation in specialized Rust.
acceptance: Minimal allow vectors pass and missing tenant, cross-tenant, wrong-role, wrong-operation and expiry vectors deny.
Attenuation cannot expand resource, operation, tenant, role or expiry.
Revocation-store outage and unknown key ID fail closed without logging token bytes.

packages.name: Tenant data, RLS and retention platform
packages.objective: Provide Bun PostgreSQL adapters, isolated owner migrations, RLS context, Redis/Cellar ports, retention jobs and deletion receipts without provisioning infrastructure.
acceptance: Two-tenant and missing-context tests deny every cross-owner or cross-tenant query.
Retention boundaries, configurable minima/maxima and active deletion produce valid evidence.
Restore replay cannot resurrect an accepted deletion and backups remain bounded to 35 days.

packages.name: Proof and Artifact capabilities
packages.objective: Implement content-addressed manifests, Evidence Reports, release candidates and deterministic verification without granting artifact bytes authority over source contracts.
acceptance: Manifest path traversal, digest mismatch and pass/fail inconsistency are refused.
Identical inputs produce identical manifests and verification output.
A release/build artifact cannot exist without a bound passing Evidence Report.

packages.name: Pure specialized Rust and WASM product engines
packages.objective: Implement only the candidate Rust/WASM boundaries for Radar, Notebook canonicalization and crypto, Model Policy and Boussole; leave Context, agent orchestration and Practices scoring unimplemented.
acceptance: Every retained product engine has cross-runtime golden vectors and an explicit TS/Rust boundary bound to a cataloged v2 WIT profile.
No product engine implementation starts while any of its read authorities remains candidate or lacks its independent named agent verdicts.
Pure WIT worlds import no network, storage, clock, randomness, identity or logging capability.
Radar enforces source-scoped identities and explicit input, output, item and depth budgets without partial results.
Notebook crypto passes independent Argon2id, AES-GCM, AAD, anti-oracle, zeroization and browser-budget review.
Policy proves human proposer/approver separation and Boussole public scoring remains release-disabled pending both hash-bound approvals.
No crates/context or crates/agent-orchestrator implementation exists in this package; notebook-core remains the sole ContextDocument canonicalization authority.
The reserved Practices scoring WIT remains unimplemented until a new approved package demonstrates a real invariant.

packages.name: Foundation integration and quality harness
packages.objective: Integrate the canonical foundation into clean-checkout CI, browser, security, supply-chain and deterministic reference-chain evidence.
acceptance: A clean checkout exercises Bun.serve, React, contracts, RLS, Biscuit, WIT, Proof, Artifact and Playwright.
All licence, advisory, source, secret, accessibility and deterministic-build gates pass in shared CI.
No Clever resource or production claim exists.

packages.name: Agent orchestration control core — simulation only
packages.objective: Implement the deterministic Rust control core for validated plans and authorizations, idempotent commands, causal events and monotone budgets against a fake harness, without launching workers or gaining process, filesystem, network, provider, secret or persistence capabilities.
acceptance: Plan, quorum, authorization, Biscuit and harness-attestation bindings fail closed before run ID allocation; the control core never computes or grants a Missions quorum.
Start, pause, resume and cancel are revisioned and idempotent; authorized cancel remains monotone while pause prevents every new simulated effect.
Event IDs, exact sequence, predecessor digests, identities, delta arithmetic and monotone totals reject gaps, divergent collisions, retries that restore budget and cross-tenant substitution.

Unknown keys, revoked authorization, authorization/causal-store outage and missing required controls refuse execution without reflecting tokens, identifiers, paths, findings or content in operational logs; nonce ownership remains exclusively in Missions.
The crate exposes no process, filesystem, network, provider, secret, persistence or Pi adapter; its fake harness and stores exist only under tests and verification fixtures.
TypeScript and Rust consume the same locked adversarial vectors and produce byte-identical closed reason codes for every covered case.
Proof and Artifact outputs remain content-addressed references; no event payload or log becomes a second evidence authority.

The package implements no durable or unbounded event ledger: it validates one transition plus a caller-supplied collision observation; replay storage and its explicit resource bounds remain a later package prerequisite for real use.
A clean dependency graph, Cargo deny, bounded property tests and deterministic replay pass without changing any locked authority or root dependency outside WP-G2-T01 integration.
No real mission, app integration, worker launch, sandbox claim, provider call, release or deployment is authorized by this package.

packages.name: Website reconstruction
packages.objective: Build the deterministic public projection, correction history, feeds, sitemap and offline search from reviewed canonical content.
acceptance: Two clean builds are byte-identical with zero unapproved remote request.
No-JS, keyboard, three-browser, feeds, sitemap, search and correction journeys pass.
Rollback atomically restores one complete prior artifact.

packages.name: Practices reconstruction
packages.objective: Build offline responsible-practice journeys, local progress/export/delete and separately authorized reviewed activity publication.
acceptance: One real reviewed activity works offline with sourced non-punitive feedback.
Progress export/delete works without account and raw answers never cross the network.
Generated or unreviewed activity publication fails closed.

packages.name: Radar reconstruction
packages.objective: Build tenant-scoped subscription, hostile fetch, deterministic curation, replay, export and deletion with bounded workers.
acceptance: SSRF, redirect, decompression, body, parser and time budgets reject malicious fixtures.
Duplicate jobs and replays produce one attributable decision per version.
Raw bodies are discarded or quarantined exactly under the retention policy.

packages.name: Notebook reconstruction
packages.objective: Build a local-only encrypted block notebook with deterministic context preview/export, backup/restore conflicts and deletion.
acceptance: Offline create/edit/search and exact preview/export survive browser reload.
Encrypted backup/restore rejects tampering and reports every divergent revision.
Network interception proves no note, index, response or key leaves the device.

packages.name: Sessions reconstruction
packages.objective: Build tenant spaces, audience-safe contributions, reconnectable events, draft synthesis, human approval, export and deletion.
acceptance: Two-instance disconnect/reconnect replays no duplicate mutation.
Private contributions never enter session exports or synthesis without explicit audience allowance.
Provider/Redis degradation preserves manual outcomes and authoritative event history.

packages.name: Model Policy reconstruction
packages.objective: Build sourced policy/snapshot authoring and deterministic local eligibility evaluation with unknown facts denied or indeterminate.
acceptance: Rust/WASM and independent reference vectors produce identical traces and hashes.
Unknown facts never produce eligible and origin is never treated as jurisdiction.
Restricted datasets are cited/digested without unauthorized redistribution.

packages.name: Boussole reconstruction
packages.objective: Build local transparent comparison over sourced public votes while keeping personal responses off every server and public score disabled by default.
acceptance: Golden vectors expose denominator, omitted votes and per-statement contributions.
Network interception proves zero response/result transmission and local deletion works.
Public scoring remains release-disabled without both hash-bound independent approvals.

packages.name: Specifications reconstruction
packages.objective: Build tenant specification workspaces, attributable review, immutable accepted packages and planning-only handoffs.
acceptance: A real package is refused with open decisions then accepted immutably after evidence.
Concurrent stale revisions and cross-tenant references fail.
Every emitted handoff contains only the plan capability and exact package digest.

packages.name: Missions reconstruction
packages.objective: Build mission proposal, risk, observation and intervention with the locked v1 human-verdict baseline plus the locked v2 two-agent quorum workflow, without executing tools in the web app.
acceptance: Every v1/v2 state and role transition, stale revision and forged event vector is exercised without reinterpreting a v1 approval as a v2 quorum.
Author, reviewer, orchestrator and harness credentials can perform only their exact operations and cannot fabricate quorum, self-validate or cross tenant.
A bounded simulated v2 mission blocks on budget and reaches technical validation only after two eligible reviewers approve the exact result digest; protected human gates remain additive.

The web app executes no tool and owns no orchestrator runtime state; real mission execution, sandbox, Pi worker and provider integration remain blocked until separate harness/worker packages and conformance gates are approved.

packages.name: Specifications to Missions evidence chain
packages.objective: Continuously integrate accepted SpecPackage, planning handoff, mission, orchestrator event, Evidence Report and Artifact manifest end to end.
acceptance: One immutable digest chain verifies from specification through human mission verdict.
Any substituted package, event, evidence or artifact digest fails.
No planning handoff grants an execution operation.

packages.name: Cross-application tenant and data conformance
packages.objective: Run adversarial session, Biscuit, RLS, retention, deletion, restore and zero-content-log vectors across every server-backed application.
acceptance: Missing/divergent tenant and every cross-app table access fail at policy and RLS layers.
Deletion and retention evidence covers PostgreSQL, Redis, search, blobs and restore replay.
Proxy and application logs contain no user/session ID, token, content or sensitive local response.

packages.name: Cross-application browser and accessibility qualification
packages.objective: Qualify all critical journeys across Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, mobile viewport, keyboard, no-JS/offline and degraded dependencies.
acceptance: Every critical journey passes keyboard and three-engine automation with explicit state labels.
Offline/local and provider/cache outage modes preserve safety and prior data.
Performance budgets are measured on production-like artifacts without third-party analytics.

packages.name: Agent harness — attested execution confinement
packages.objective: Realize the confinement boundary a worker cannot argue its way out of: profile resolution and digesting, filesystem canonicalization with symlink policy, bounded outputs with a fail-closed scan, and a signed attestation binding requested profile, effective controls, worker manifests and kernel capabilities. Local process confinement only; network, secrets and providers stay closed.
acceptance: Every refusal code of the specification is reachable by an adversarial test written before the control it attacks.
A symlink and a path traversal escaping the workspace root are both refused after canonicalization, on the host's real semantics.
No attestation is emitted with an incomplete binding or without a signature; requested and effective controls are recorded as distinct fields.
An attestation verifies independently from the run that produced it, given only the profile digest and the public key.
A capability closed by ADR-0018 D2 is refused even when the profile declares it.

packages.name: Orchestrator runtime — governed agent run control
packages.objective: Turn an authorized execution plan into a bounded, observable run: consume execution authorizations issued by Missions, enforce agent facts and per-agent revocation fail-closed, apply control-document budgets and liveness limits, append an immutable event chain, and halt with a decision dossier. Capabilities land in a separate crate so the accepted simulation-only core is not widened.
acceptance: A run cannot open without an execution authorization whose plan digest matches the plan body; self-authorization is refused.
Cross-tenant run access is denied at the storage layer, proven by a two-tenant integration test.
Replaying an event chain reconstructs run state byte-identically, and a broken predecessor digest is refused.
No step executes without a harness attestation binding the profile that was requested.
Store concurrency, RLS, need-to-know exports, retention and deletion/restore are qualified per ADR-0004 §6.

packages.name: Orchestrator native authorized-execution core
packages.objective: Execute the locked graph, causal replay, human-decision, generation-transfer and effect-attestation semantics as deterministic pure Rust decisions without opening a runtime capability.
acceptance: The exact SDK Rust and Contracts lock-authority commits are pinned and verified directly from the checkout.
All 54 locked semantic vectors execute independently in Rust with their literal outcomes and exact domain inventory.
Replay is deterministic, routing is closed and declaration-order independent, budgets are monotone, and unavailable observations refuse closed.
Five fake-harness crash cut points prove no blind retry, no false success and at most one fake external commit.
The source capability gate proves no I/O, clock, secret, persistence, provider or framework capability entered the crate.
Rust tests, clippy, benchmark, Bun gates, license/reuse gates, role-separated review and feature/post-merge CI are green.

packages.name: Clever Cloud EU integration environment
packages.objective: Only after G3 acceptance, configure the minimum Paris EU applications, PostgreSQL, Redis, Cellar, DNS, secrets and observability required by the global candidate.
acceptance: All resources are minimum-sized, Paris/EU-resident and recorded without secret values.
Private networks, TLS, backup ceilings and least-privilege identities verify.
Destroy/recreate procedures preserve evidence and never use historical production data.

packages.name: Global deployed hardening and rollback
packages.objective: Qualify the single integrated candidate for security, privacy, accessibility, performance, operations, migration, backup, restore and rollback.
acceptance: The deployed candidate passes all local/CI evidence plus external network and browser smoke.
Backup restore replays deletions and rollback restores compatible artifacts without data resurrection.
SBOM, provenance, operational runbooks and incident paths bind one immutable candidate.

packages.name: Single global cutover
packages.objective: Perform one approved switch of public surfaces to the qualified candidate with observable rollback and no product-by-product compatibility phase.
acceptance: One immutable release manifest names every app, contract, migration and evidence digest.
Public switching and rollback checkpoints are observed without partial product cutovers.
Legacy archives remain read-only and no compatibility endpoint survives.

packages.name: Sovereign distribution and independent reproduction
packages.objective: Publish one-way projections, packages, documentation, context packs and verification evidence that an independent actor can reproduce.
acceptance: An independent clean environment reconstructs and verifies every published capability.
All projections are one-way, content-addressed and carry licence/provenance notices.
No projection becomes a second writable authority or leaks secrets/private data.
